classification_notes.description: POST /admin/principals/{id}/keys/{key_id}/{revoke|disable|enable} are backend compatibility routes. Admin Web uses only the v1 issue/revoke routes; disable/enable remain direct API or operator-CLI-only.

No Admin Web caller exists for POST /admin/v1/router/preview, POST /admin/v1/principals/{principal_id}/plugin-chain/rebalance, or PUT /admin/v1/plugin-chain-entries/{id}; each is cataloged with its source behavior and parameters.

POST /admin/v1/router/preview is intentionally a read-only POST because its simulation input is a JSON body. It performs no storage query, audit append, external request, cache mutation, or persistent side effect.

The registered POST /admin[/v1]/config/apply handler calls CurrentConfig::apply_draft_config and appends an admin audit event. It does not call the separate settings::apply_config file/history workflow, so no ConfigStore::append_config_history SQL is attributed to these endpoints.
PATCH /admin/v1/plugins/registry/{id} updates the registry label and dynamic view but does not call record_admin_audit; no audit operation is attributed.

POST /admin/v1/plugins/wasm/gc deletes only orphan blobs (sha256 absent from wasm_registry_v2) and their local cache files — registry-referenced blobs are kept even at refcount 0 — and does not emit an admin audit event.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Returns full status object including principals, plugin_chain_summary, killswitch, last_reload_status, restart_required_changes.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Returns simplified status object containing only version, git_sha, rust_version, profile, target, uptime_secs, replica_id, generation, upstreams.
classification_notes.impact: Clients expecting killswitch, principals, or restart_required_changes in /admin/v1/status receive undefined in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Accepts query params: since, until, limit, principal_id. No actor filtering. No SensitiveRead authorization enforcement.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Accepts additional query params: actor_authority, actor_subject. Enforces validation that both actor params must be supplied together and cannot be combined with principal_id. Enforces SensitiveRead authorization.
classification_notes.impact: In deployed, querying by actor_authority or actor_subject is ignored/not supported. In latest, missing permissions return 403 Forbidden.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Fetches event detail from storage without RBAC check or audit logging.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Requires SensitiveRead permission (returns 403 if unauthorized) and logs 'request_event_detail_read' audit event.
classification_notes.impact: Requires authenticated identity with read permission in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Exports config and chains without RBAC check or audit logging.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Requires SensitiveRead permission (403 on denial) and logs 'config_export' audit event (500 audit_write_failed if audit write fails).
classification_notes.impact: Protected by RBAC in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Accepts arbitrary extra JSON fields in request body; uses best-effort audit emission.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Enforces serde(deny_unknown_fields) on IssueKeyRequest; uses record_issue_audit_or_revoke (rolls back key creation if audit write fails).
classification_notes.impact: Stricter payload validation and transactional audit guarantees in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Lists keys for principal without SensitiveRead check or audit logging.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Requires SensitiveRead permission (403 if unauthorized) and logs 'principal_keys_list' audit event.
classification_notes.impact: Protected by RBAC in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Logs audit record with hardcoded actor 'admin' and principal_id 'admin'.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Logs audit record with resolved actor metadata (actor_authority, actor_subject, actor_kind, actor_email).
classification_notes.impact: Audit records contain structured actor identity in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Synchronously checks localStorage for cclb_admin_token. If found, mounts children immediately. Form submit sets localStorage and unblocks without API validation.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Asynchronously calls GET /admin/v1/auth/session to validate token and identify actor. Shows loading spinner. Differentiates between static_token and external auth mode.
classification_notes.impact: In deployed, the app will never make a network request on startup to verify the token, and does not support external auth redirect.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Admin Token card is unconditionally rendered.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Admin Token card is conditionally rendered only when auth_mode === 'static_token'.
classification_notes.impact: Under external auth in latest, Admin Token card is hidden.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Table has 6 columns: Revision, Applied, Upstreams, Principals, Plugins, TLS.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Table has 3 columns: Revision, Applied, TLS.
classification_notes.impact: UI columns removed to match backend HistorySummary simplification.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Returns audit entries oldest first (ORDER BY id/seq ASC) via AuditStore::query_audit / query_audit_by_actor.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: returns entries newest first (ORDER BY ts DESC, id/seq DESC) via new AuditStore::query_recent_audit with AuditQueryScope (All | Principal | Actor); scope filters apply before LIMIT. 'after' remains an exclusive lower time bound (since = max(since, after+1)), not a forward pagination cursor. Ascending query_audit/query_audit_by_actor trait methods remain defined but are no longer used by the HTTP audit handler.
classification_notes.impact: Entry order reverses vs deployed; clients paging by position see newest-first pages. Candidate only - not committed or deployed.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: UpstreamResponse has no base_url field.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: UpstreamResponse adds base_url (Option<Url>, serialized as nullable string); frontend UpstreamSchema (web/src/lib/api.ts:784) requires the base_url key (nullable) and createUpstreamFromOauthDraft parses the response through UpstreamSchema.
classification_notes.impact: Deployed responses lack base_url; candidate frontend schema validation fails against a backend that omits the key. Candidate only.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Omitted label becomes empty string; both stores run validate_identifier on the empty label and reject it; any KeyStoreError maps to 500.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: empty label skips validate_identifier on both SqliteStorage and PostgresStorage (label optional); KeyStoreError::Storage(InvalidInput{field,reason}) maps to 400 {error:'invalid_input',field,reason}; other errors remain 500.
classification_notes.impact: Key issuance without a label succeeds in candidate; client input errors surface as 400 invalid_input instead of 500. Candidate only.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: handleSave has no reentrancy guard; blur after Enter (or rapid Enter/blur) can issue a second PUT /admin/v1/upstreams/{id} with a stale spec_revision.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: saveStartedRef latch allows a single submission per edit session; entering edit mode resets the latch; Escape sets the latch so the subsequent blur cannot save.
classification_notes.impact: Duplicate rename submissions eliminated in candidate. Candidate only.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: enable/disable invalidates only ['principals']; allowed_models, default_limits and cache_keepalive PATCH invalidate ['principal',id]+['principals']; router-terminal PUT invalidates only ['router-terminal',id]. Router revision shown by useRouterTerminal can stay stale after non-router principal mutations.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: all five mutations plus the router-terminal PUT funnel through invalidatePrincipalRecordQueries, invalidating ['principal',id], ['principals'] and ['router-terminal',id] together; qk.routerTerminal and qk.pluginReferences key factories added.
classification_notes.impact: Router revision refreshes after every principal mutation in candidate. Candidate only.

classification_notes.target: crates/cc-lb-admin/web/src/components/plugins/PluginCatalog.tsx + PluginDeleteDialog.tsx + queries.ts (plugin delete lifecycle and GC)
classification_notes.deployed_behavior: GC button 'Delete unused uploads' disabled when zero unused uploads; toast 'Deleted N unused uploads'; per-row delete disabled during sweep; dialog uses del.mutate with local onSuccess toast; usePluginReferences cached normally and invalidated on delete.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: GC button 'Clean orphaned uploads' always enabled (gcInFlight latch and gcPending guard remain), toasts 'No orphaned upload blobs found' / 'Removed N orphaned upload blobs', progress label 'Cleaning orphaned uploads'; row delete no longer disabled during sweep; dialog awaits del.mutateAsync, relies on the shared MutationCache error toast, supports onDeleted callback; usePluginReferences gcTime:0, delete cancels the in-flight reference query and removes the inactive cache entry on success.
classification_notes.impact: GC presentation clarifies that only unreferenced WASM blobs are removed (registered plugins kept even at Used By 0); delete lifecycle hardened against stale reference cache. Candidate only.

classification_notes.name: Explicit-null Base URL override clearing
classification_notes.description: Approved on 2026-09-16: PUT/PATCH omission preserves base_url, explicit null clears it, URL sets it. Both adapters preserve revision/credential semantics. Deployed baseline remains unchanged.

classification_notes.name: Provider-aware configuration draft Apply availability
classification_notes.description: Approved on 2026-09-16: draft responses expose required apply_supported from the real provider. Only explicit true may enable Apply alongside existing validation/revision checks. Unsupported and unconfirmed states show Apply-specific accessible guidance. Existing apply/reload implementations are unchanged; file-backed provider remains unsupported.

classification_notes.impact: Protected by RBAC in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Logs audit record with hardcoded actor 'admin' and principal_id 'admin'.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Logs audit record with resolved actor metadata (actor_authority, actor_subject, actor_kind, actor_email).
classification_notes.impact: Audit records contain structured actor identity in latest.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Synchronously checks localStorage for cclb_admin_token. If found, mounts children immediately. Form submit sets localStorage and unblocks without API validation.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Asynchronously calls GET /admin/v1/auth/session to validate token and identify actor. Shows loading spinner. Differentiates between static_token and external auth mode.
classification_notes.impact: In deployed, the app will never make a network request on startup to verify the token, and does not support external auth redirect.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Admin Token card is unconditionally rendered.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Admin Token card is conditionally rendered only when auth_mode === 'static_token'.
classification_notes.impact: Under external auth in latest, Admin Token card is hidden.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Table has 6 columns: Revision, Applied, Upstreams, Principals, Plugins, TLS.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Table has 3 columns: Revision, Applied, TLS.
classification_notes.impact: UI columns removed to match backend HistorySummary simplification.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Returns audit entries oldest first (ORDER BY id/seq ASC) via AuditStore::query_audit / query_audit_by_actor.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: returns entries newest first (ORDER BY ts DESC, id/seq DESC) via new AuditStore::query_recent_audit with AuditQueryScope (All | Principal | Actor); scope filters apply before LIMIT. 'after' remains an exclusive lower time bound (since = max(since, after+1)), not a forward pagination cursor. Ascending query_audit/query_audit_by_actor trait methods remain defined but are no longer used by the HTTP audit handler.
classification_notes.impact: Entry order reverses vs deployed; clients paging by position see newest-first pages. Candidate only - not committed or deployed.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: UpstreamResponse has no base_url field.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: UpstreamResponse adds base_url (Option<Url>, serialized as nullable string); frontend UpstreamSchema (web/src/lib/api.ts:784) requires the base_url key (nullable) and createUpstreamFromOauthDraft parses the response through UpstreamSchema.
classification_notes.impact: Deployed responses lack base_url; candidate frontend schema validation fails against a backend that omits the key. Candidate only.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: Omitted label becomes empty string; both stores run validate_identifier on the empty label and reject it; any KeyStoreError maps to 500.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: empty label skips validate_identifier on both SqliteStorage and PostgresStorage (label optional); KeyStoreError::Storage(InvalidInput{field,reason}) maps to 400 {error:'invalid_input',field,reason}; other errors remain 500.
classification_notes.impact: Key issuance without a label succeeds in candidate; client input errors surface as 400 invalid_input instead of 500. Candidate only.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: handleSave has no reentrancy guard; blur after Enter (or rapid Enter/blur) can issue a second PUT /admin/v1/upstreams/{id} with a stale spec_revision.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: saveStartedRef latch allows a single submission per edit session; entering edit mode resets the latch; Escape sets the latch so the subsequent blur cannot save.
classification_notes.impact: Duplicate rename submissions eliminated in candidate. Candidate only.

classification_notes.deployed_behavior: enable/disable invalidates only ['principals']; allowed_models, default_limits and cache_keepalive PATCH invalidate ['principal',id]+['principals']; router-terminal PUT invalidates only ['router-terminal',id]. Router revision shown by useRouterTerminal can stay stale after non-router principal mutations.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: all five mutations plus the router-terminal PUT funnel through invalidatePrincipalRecordQueries, invalidating ['principal',id], ['principals'] and ['router-terminal',id] together; qk.routerTerminal and qk.pluginReferences key factories added.
classification_notes.impact: Router revision refreshes after every principal mutation in candidate. Candidate only.

classification_notes.target: crates/cc-lb-admin/web/src/components/plugins/PluginCatalog.tsx + PluginDeleteDialog.tsx + queries.ts (plugin delete lifecycle and GC)
classification_notes.deployed_behavior: GC button 'Delete unused uploads' disabled when zero unused uploads; toast 'Deleted N unused uploads'; per-row delete disabled during sweep; dialog uses del.mutate with local onSuccess toast; usePluginReferences cached normally and invalidated on delete.
classification_notes.latest_behavior: Uncommitted candidate: GC button 'Clean orphaned uploads' always enabled (gcInFlight latch and gcPending guard remain), toasts 'No orphaned upload blobs found' / 'Removed N orphaned upload blobs', progress label 'Cleaning orphaned uploads'; row delete no longer disabled during sweep; dialog awaits del.mutateAsync, relies on the shared MutationCache error toast, supports onDeleted callback; usePluginReferences gcTime:0, delete cancels the in-flight reference query and removes the inactive cache entry on success.
classification_notes.impact: GC presentation clarifies that only unreferenced WASM blobs are removed (registered plugins kept even at Used By 0); delete lifecycle hardened against stale reference cache. Candidate only.

classification_notes.name: Explicit-null Base URL override clearing
classification_notes.description: Approved on 2026-09-16: PUT/PATCH omission preserves base_url, explicit null clears it, URL sets it. Both adapters preserve revision/credential semantics. Deployed baseline remains unchanged.

classification_notes.name: Provider-aware configuration draft Apply availability
classification_notes.description: Approved on 2026-09-16: draft responses expose required apply_supported from the real provider. Only explicit true may enable Apply alongside existing validation/revision checks. Unsupported and unconfirmed states show Apply-specific accessible guidance. Existing apply/reload implementations are unchanged; file-backed provider remains unsupported.

classification_notes.reason: Credentials page deprecated and removed in favor of upstream-specific credentials
Dedicated /status page removed in favor of Settings and Metrics views

gaps.title: Token storage key mismatch between inventory and source
gaps.description: The legacy inventory documented localStorage['cclb.auth.token'], whereas the actual codebase uses AUTH_TOKEN_KEY = 'cc-lb-admin-token' in src/lib/auth.ts:1.

gaps.title: Theme storage key and application method mismatch
gaps.description: The legacy inventory documented localStorage['theme'] with .dark class toggling. The actual codebase uses STORAGE_KEY = 'cclb.theme' in src/lib/theme.ts:10 and sets data-theme attribute on document.documentElement.

gaps.title: Command Palette Pages group missing Audit route
gaps.description: CommandPalette.tsx lists Overview, Upstreams, Principals, Plugins, Logs, and Settings in the Pages group, but omits the /audit route, even though it exists in Sidebar.tsx.

gaps.title: Usage endpoint path mismatch
gaps.description: The legacy inventory documented GET /admin/dashboard/usage for UI-OV-02. The actual codebase requests GET /admin/usage with query parameters range, step, group_by=principal, and projection=totals.

gaps.title: Quota pool history and snapshot endpoints split
gaps.description: The legacy inventory documented a single GET /admin/dashboard/pool-history endpoint for UI-OV-03, UI-OV-04, and UI-OV-07C. The actual codebase splits this into two distinct endpoints: GET /admin/v1/subscription-quotas/aggregate (snapshot stacked bars) and GET /admin/v1/subscription-quotas/pool-history (multi-series Recharts area chart).

gaps.title: Event detail query missing from UI-OV-12 inventory item
gaps.description: UI-OV-12 was documented purely as a UI row click action, but selecting any finalized request row triggers an asynchronous network fetch to GET /admin/v1/events/detail/{eventId} via useRequestEventDetail.

SSE reconnect delta query (/admin/v1/events/delta) is only called when lastCursor is known and resumeNeedsBackfill is true. If connection drops on initial load before any event arrives, it reconnects directly without backfill.
gaps.mitigation: Verified: tested in useLiveEventStream tests; initial cursor null connects directly to /admin/events/stream.

gaps.description: Model filter is debounced by 300ms in client. Fast typing will not issue network requests per keystroke, but typing rapidly across the 300ms boundary produces sequential queries.

gaps.area: Cache Keepalive Sessions List Query Limit
gaps.observation: useCacheKeepaliveSummary explicitly queries with limit=0 to return metrics without rows. However, useCacheKeepaliveSessions does not specify a limit parameter, causing the request to omit limit and rely on backend default pagination size (e.g. 50 or 100).

HorizonToggle with 'all' sends horizon=all in the query string. In contrast, status filter 'all' omits the status parameter entirely (undefined). The 'error' filter chip also omits status but sets error=true in the query string.

Changing the horizon value creates a distinct TanStack Query key (['cache-keepalive', 'sessions', principalId, { horizon, ... }]). This resets the infinite query cursor back to page 1 (pageParam: undefined). Cursor metadata is not shared across horizons.
The LLM Judge control in CacheKeepaliveSettingsDrawer is visually rendered with opacity-50 and a badge 'Reserved for a future release', with no interactive handler or backend wire mapping.
ApiKeysCard explicitly prevents Escape, backdrop click, or close button dismissal while a newly generated plaintext key is displayed, requiring the operator to click 'Done' after copying.

gaps.description: WASM binary download feature is completely missing from both backend and frontend. The prompt asks for 'download' tracking, but neither GET /admin/v1/plugins/wasm/{id} nor any export button in PluginDetailIntegrity / PluginCatalog exists.
gaps.workaround: Operators must retain original .wasm files offline; wasm bytecode cannot be downloaded back from the dashboard.

gaps.description: Four REST endpoints implemented in crates/cc-lb-admin/src/v1/plugins.rs are never called by the admin web UI: (1) GET /admin/v1/plugins/registry/{id} (UI fetches whole registry and finds by ID in memory), (2) POST /admin/v1/principals/{principal_id}/plugin-chain/rebalance (re-spacing order integers), (3) GET /admin/v1/plugin-chain-entries/{id} (single chain entry fetch), and (4) PUT /admin/v1/plugin-chain-entries/{id} (single chain entry update).
gaps.workaround: Document as backend-only endpoints; UI uses list and insert/delete primitives.

gaps.description: PluginDetailOperate displays static text indicating 'Health metrics for individual plugins are not yet available in the dashboard' and points to raw Prometheus metric names (cc_lb_plugin_call_duration_seconds, cc_lb_plugin_trap_total). There is no live telemetry or chart in the UI.
gaps.workaround: Operators must use external Prometheus / Grafana dashboards for plugin latency and trap metrics.

gaps.title: No Config Diff Modal in UI (Backend-Only Endpoint)
gaps.description: GET /admin/config/diff?from={revA}&to={revB} and qk.configDiff query key exist, but there is NO UI caller, modal, or comparison button in Admin Web. History rows in ConfigHistorySection are static table rows with no expansion or comparison triggers.
gaps.resolution: Confirmed absent in UI. Marked as API-BACKEND-CONFIG-DIFF with Web-Unreachable status; no fake UI modal should be generated.

gaps.title: No Config Draft Discard API or UI Action
gaps.description: Neither the backend axum routes (routes.rs) nor the frontend (settings.tsx) implements a draft discard / rollback endpoint or button. An operator must manually overwrite the draft text with the current configuration to discard draft changes.
gaps.resolution: Documented in state transition rules; no discard button exists in current source.

gaps.title: Audit Query Hardcoded Limit and Missing Pagination Controls
gaps.description: AuditPage requests useAudit with limit='200'. The UI table displays at most 200 admin rows and a static 'No more entries' footer. There are no next/previous page buttons, cursor tokens, or infinite scrolling.
gaps.resolution: Documented as fixed-cap single-page query. Users must use time range bounds (since/until) and principal filters to inspect older or segmented events.

gaps.title: Audit Client-Side Admin Action Filtering
gaps.description: GET /admin/audit returns all audit_log_v1 rows matching query bounds, but the UI client explicitly filters for entries where admin_action != null || kind != null. Regular proxy request logs returned by the endpoint are silently omitted from the table view.
gaps.resolution: Documented in audit renderRows filtering logic.

gaps.description: WarmupConfigModal is conditionally rendered when pluginSnapshot exists with open={configOpen}, but configOpen is initialized to false and no button or interaction anywhere in WarmupCardMinimal or the UI ever calls setConfigOpen(true). It is an unreachable dead modal in production.
WarmupRecentStrip is exported in parts/WarmupRecentStrip.tsx but is never imported or rendered by any component or route in the entire admin web application.
Triggering Fire Now sends an actual /messages payload directly upstream to Anthropic, burning real account tokens and potentially incurring billable usage or rate limit depletion.
Static source reconciliation does not prove browser behavior, production entity coverage, latency, or deployed availability.
No deployed-delta.json has been supplied yet; latest-source items stay out of an asserted production-complete matrix until applicability is reconciled.
No Admin Web action or backend route discards a config draft.
GET /admin/config/diff exists but has no Admin Web caller.
The UI downloads a database export from GET /admin/v1/export; it has no standalone config download action.
Neither frontend nor backend exposes uploaded WASM bytecode download.

The env:{api_key_env} display branch is source-only/unreachable because UpstreamResponse omits api_key_env. That write-only credential contract is unchanged. The separately approved Base URL null-clear contract is now implemented and is recorded in SettingsCard variants; historical null-as-no-change evidence remains a baseline limitation.
